patthana18.13:1.1: hetuñceva hetu sampayuttañca hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu ceva na hetuvippayutto ceva na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana18.13:2.1: hetu sampayuttañceva na ca hetuṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu vippayutto ceva na na ca hetu na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā ekaṃ.
